string-array.name: municipality_info
string-array.item: Beijing is the capital of China. It has a long history and many famous landmarks such as the Great Wall and the Forbidden City.
Shanghai is a modern international city. It is famous for its skyline, the Bund and fast economic development.
Tianjin is a coastal municipality near Beijing. It mixes western-style buildings and traditional local food culture.
Chongqing is a mountain city in southwest China. It is well-known for hot pot and unique layered city scenery.
